Catalog compound positions on a padded canvas

Source: R/placement.R
catalog_pixel_positions.Rd

Maps every compound's observations onto an H x W canvas. When the catalog records a dms_grid(), observations are placed from their seconds / volts through the grid (centred if the canvas is larger). Otherwise they are laid out the way pad_to_target() lays out real samples: each observation's fraction position is converted with its own sample's unpadded data dims (catalog$parameters$data_dims) and centre-padding offset. This is the frame the synthetic generators render in and the frame the encoder sees for real samples.

Usage

catalog_pixel_positions(catalog, H, W)

Arguments

catalog

A peak_catalog.

H, W

Canvas dimensions in pixels.

Value

A tibble with one row per compound: compound_id, rt_px, cv_px (median 1-based canvas pixel over the compound's observations, or the centroid when it has none), and rt_px_sd, cv_px_sd (SD of the observations' canvas pixels; 0 with fewer than two).

Details

Catalogs built before data dims were recorded fall back to fraction * H (with a once-per-session warning).
